title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: wellness-reimbursement payment-based ceiling
content:
The amount waived may also never exceed 3 times the total payments the employer's master account has made toward this enrollment in the trailing 12 months ending at the time of the waiver. Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, this limit guards against reimbursing more than a reasonable multiple of what has actually been remitted; a waiver granted before any payment has been posted has no payment history to size it against, and computes to zero under this ceiling alone.

Worked example (hypothetical): if the employer's master account had made total payments of $40.00 toward the enrollment in the trailing 12 months, the payment-based ceiling on a wellness-reimbursement waiver would be 3 times that figure, $120.00. If no payment had yet been posted in that trailing 12 months, the payment-based ceiling would be zero, and a waiver attempted before any payment would compute to zero under this ceiling alone.
